justification: A public-copy change: how-it-works, about and contact are rewritten for the private pilot, terms gains a pilot notice, and the link test now covers these pages

falsifiable_check.fails_when: how-it-works, about, contact or terms links to any internal page outside the allowed list
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the rewrite the extended test listed how-it-works, contact and the blog link as offenders; after it the list is empty

pre_impl.existing_data: Reads PILOT_COUNCIL_LABELS from lib/pilot-focus.ts and PLAN_BRIEF_ON from lib/site-report.ts; nothing is written
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If the clause lists are switched off the how-it-works step 3 wording drops the clause-and-page promise; the flag is read at build time
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every page view after deploy; no data or routes change
pre_impl.frontend_type: No type changes; copy and one test list
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A visitor reading the company pages no longer sees offers or counts for tools that are not part of the pilot

functions.name: HowItWorksPage
functions.input: no inputs, a plain server component
functions.output: the short pilot how-it-works page with its limits list
functions.if_none: there are no inputs, so nothing can be missing

functions.name: AboutPage
functions.input: no inputs, a plain server component
functions.output: the short pilot about page with its data sources
functions.if_none: there are no inputs, so nothing can be missing

values.if_missing: the flag is a build-time boolean that reads false when unset, so the clause-and-page wording is not shown

break_it.scenario: A later edit links the contact page to an old tool
break_it.what_happens: The extended link test fails and CI blocks the change
break_it.how: The four company pages are now in the navigation file list of the pilot link test

break_it.scenario: The terms page still describes paid reports and other tools below the notice
break_it.what_happens: A reader sees both the notice and the older product descriptions
break_it.how: Known limit: the legal clauses were not edited; the notice says paid reports and other tools are not offered during the pilot, and a solicitor should review the terms

break_it.scenario: The clause lists are switched off at build time
break_it.what_happens: how-it-works step 3 says controls are shown with a clause and a link, not clause lists
break_it.how: The step wording and the homepage subline both read PLAN_BRIEF_ON
break_it.repro: build with NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAN_BRIEF unset and read /how-it-works

post_merge.manual_verify: Open /how-it-works, /about, /contact and /terms on the preview and read each once: no tool offers, counts or prices; terms shows the Private pilot notice above clause 1
